turns.teacher: Good morning children! Today we will do subtraction with our bundles and sticks. Let us start with fifty two minus twenty seven.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five. Tell me, how did you get the five in the ones place?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Okay Ravi, so you did seven take away two because seven is bigger. Look at the top number. How many loose sticks do we have in fifty two?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Yes, only two loose sticks. Come Ravi, take these two sticks in your hand. Can you give me seven sticks from only two?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Not enough, no? So open one bundle of ten. Untie it, Ravi. Now count all the loose sticks together. How many?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Twelve! Very nice, Ravi, you opened the bundle and counted twelve ones. Now take away seven from twelve.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana, you are sitting so nicely. Can you tell us how many bundles are left after Ravi opened one?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Four bundles, take away two bundles. So the answer is twenty five. Thumbs up if you agree with twenty five.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now Ravi, you try this one with sticks. Forty three minus eighteen. First check the ones: can you take eight from three?
turns.label: new_sum
